governed_construct: A rendered chart component (JSX element) whose binding resolves to a value export of a charting library (react-native-svg-charts, react-native-chart-kit, victory/victory-native, recharts, react-native-gifted-charts, ...), used to plot time/duration distribution data. Each such JSX element is one instance; type-only imports from charting libraries and non-chart code are not instances.
interpretation: The rule asks that time-distribution charts be drawn with react-native-svg-charts. Within one file, every JSX element that renders a component bound to a charting-library value export is an instance; it conforms iff that binding resolves to react-native-svg-charts (named, aliased or namespace import, including its axes/grid/progress components). An instance bound to any other charting library (via import, alias, namespace, or TS import-equals/require) is VIOLATED, even if svg-charts is also used in the same file. Files that only compute or format time data with no chart are NOT_APPLICABLE. Importing a TYPE (e.g. ChartConfig) from another chart library without rendering its components does not violate the rule, since no chart is drawn with it; deciding whether an imported name is a type or a value needs type information, as does resolving which module a JSX tag is bound to. All fixtures plot time data, so the 'time distribution' qualifier is held constant rather than judged.
